# LP Web Studio

> Cape Town systems studio building custom ordering portals,
client platforms, and business automation that replace manual
admin for South African businesses. Founded by Luke Petzer.

## Services
- Custom ordering portals and client platforms (from R35,000)
- Business automation and WhatsApp-to-system migration
- Custom web applications and business systems
- Monthly care plans (from R1,950/month)

LP Web Studio does not build standalone marketing websites.

## Products
- B2B Ordering Platform — branded ordering portal for wholesalers
  and distributors. Live catalogue, per-client pricing, credit or
  EFT checkout, admin dashboard, installable on customers' phones.
  From R12,500 setup + R1,950/month. Optional payments add-on from
  R6,500 setup + R450/month.
- lp-os — internal business command centre for clients, projects,
  and admin. Currently in a limited pilot programme.
